## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test` pass locally
- [ ] `npm run validate:content` passes (if content changed) and `npm run seed:build` was re-run
- [ ] New UI has accessibility labels, ≥44pt targets and respects reduced motion
- [ ] No ads, tracking, external links or new permissions in the child experience
- [ ] New stories/assets have a recorded source + licence and are listed in `docs/CONTENT_RIGHTS.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (user-facing changes)
